reason: Eventar org scope for event lists had three inline copies (dashboards, /checkin, /analytics) that relied on app-level eq filters while RLS exposes all published events. Extracted to ownEvents(). A future list added inline would reintroduce the cross-org leak, so the rule and its verification belong in one project skill.

Episode changed the "Events this week" tile to a rolling count and fixed its footer after two review agents flagged label and footer mismatches. The dashboard-tile rules are not in this skill, and the list-cap caveat was surfaced but unrecorded.

The ownEvents() signature now rejects non-literal column strings at compile time, and the peer-written skill does not say so. A future session that passes a computed column list would hit an opaque tsc error and might widen the type to make it pass, reopening the untyped-any path.

The dashboard fetched registrations for every listed event id in one .in() call. At 242 events that URL hit a 414 and crashed /dashboard and /dashboard/manage. This skill covers the list, so it should warn that a second lookup keyed on the listed ids can hit the same limit and point at the general batching rule.

Review found the door picker (staff list) had the same limit-before-filter bug as the public listing. Fix needed a query predicate, a tie-break order, and a fake operator. These belong to the skill that governs event lists and pickers.
